content.text:
在桑给巴尔,Harees 叫 **Boko Boko**(也拼作 Bokoboko 或 "boko")。

依据:
- Bokoboko 食谱页面说这道阿拉伯式的肉和小麦粥(Harees/Hareesa)在桑给巴尔和蒙巴萨很有名:https://donimranfamilykitchen.wordpress.com/2020/11/08/bokoboko-recipe-arabic-style-haleem-known-as-harees-or-hareesa-famous-in-zanzibar-and-mombasa/
- 斋月食谱博客写道 "The Zanzibari version is called 'boko'":http://suroorasia.blogspot.com/2016/06/recipes-for-ramadhan-harees.html

搜索结果里还有两个 Hugging Face 上的评测数据集页面,内容是这道题本身和各模型的作答。我没有把它们当作依据,上面只用了两个烹饪类网页。
